verdict.rationale: Portkey's virtual keys/model catalog explicitly let platform engineers mint provider-agnostic API keys that map to real provider credentials, which are stored securely and never exposed in code, while budgets, rate limits, and model allow-lists can be enforced per key at org/workspace level for teams and apps. This directly matches minting gateway-managed keys without exposing raw provider keys. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and detail on per-team/app key issuance workflow (e.g., self-service or RBAC-scoped key creation) rather than admin-level config.
